Based on the screenshot (which appears to be **Google Flow** or a similar AI creative studio interface), here is the precise technical specification for recreation:

### 1. Overall Layout Structure
*   **Architecture:** Three-column layout with a fixed global header.
*   **Dimensions:**
    *   **Left Sidebar:** Fixed width, approximately **240px–260px**. Contains navigation and utility links.
    *   **Center Stage (Main):** Fluid width, taking up remaining space (approx. 50-60% of viewport). This is the "canvas" or empty state area.
    *   **Right Panel:** Fixed width, approximately **360px–400px**. This is the active session/composer panel.
    *   **Header:** Fixed height (~56px), spans full width at the top with a distinct background color (slightly lighter than the main bg).
*   **Z-Index Layering:** Header is top-most; Sidebars are below header but above the center stage if overlapping occurs.

### 2. Sidebar Contents (Left Navigation)
*   **Top Section (Primary Nav):**
    *   **Active Item:** "All media" – Has a rounded rectangle background highlight (dark gray `#333` or `#3c3c3c`) with white text and an icon (grid/layout icon).
    *   **Inactive Items:** "Characters" (person icon), "Scenes" (calendar/filmstrip icon). These have transparent backgrounds, light gray text (`#9aa0a6`), and hover states that slightly lighten the background.
    *   **Separator:** A subtle 1px horizontal line (`#3c4043`) separates primary nav from tools.
    *   **Secondary Item:** "Tools" (sparkle/grid icon).
*   **Bottom Section (Utilities):**
    *   Positioned at the absolute bottom of the sidebar.
    *   Items: "Trash" (trash can icon), "Collapse" (panel-collapse icon).
    *   Styling matches inactive nav items (gray text, icon + label left-aligned).
*   **Footer Note:** Small disclaimer text at very bottom-left: *"Google Flow can make mistakes, so double check it"* in muted gray (`#5f6368`), font size ~11-12px.

### 3. Center Chat/Canvas Area (Empty State)
*   **Content:** Currently displays an **empty state** (no chat history loaded).
*   **Centerpiece:** A large pixel-art style flower or geometric icon (white/light gray) centered vertically and horizontally.
*   **Headline:** Below the icon, text reads **"Start creating or drop media"** in a medium-light gray (`#e8eaed`), font size ~18-20px, weight 400 (regular).
*   **Background:** Pure black or near-black (`#000000` or `#121212`).

### 4. Right Panel (Session & Composer)
This panel acts as the "active chat" container.

**A. Panel Header:**
*   **Title Bar:** Darker than the panel body (`#1e1e1e` or similar).
*   **Left:** Hamburger menu icon (three lines) + Bold text **"Untitled session"**.
*   **Right:** Edit/pencil icon, Close/X icon.
*   **Spacing:** Generous padding (~16px vertical).

**B. Suggestion Cards (Pre-prompt options):**
*   **Prompt Text:** Large, centered, semi-transparent text: *"What would you like to create?"* (color `#5f6368`, size ~20px).
*   **Cards:** Three stacked rectangular cards below the prompt.
    *   **Styling:** Rounded corners (12-16px), background color `#2d2d2d` (slightly lighter than black), subtle border or shadow.
    *   **Layout:** Horizontal flex. Left side has a square icon/image (colorful 3D-style icons: stacked papers, colorful pills/capsules, blue book). Right side has bold white text:
        1.  "Create a few versions of an image"
        2.  "Turn a concept into prompts"
        3.  "Teach me about what you can do"
    *   **Hover:** Likely lifts slightly or border brightens.

**C. Composer/Input Area (Bottom of Right Panel):**
*   **Container:** Rounded rectangle (border-radius ~24px), dark background (`#2d2d2d` or `#333`), distinct from the panel background.
*   **Internal Layout:**
    *   **Placeholder Text:** *"What do you want to create?"* in gray, positioned at top-left of input area.
    *   **Left Button:** Small circular button with "+" icon (for attachments/options).
    *   **Right Buttons (Grouped):**
        *   Gallery/Image icon (square with mountain).
        *   Microphone/audio icon (waveform).
        *   Send/Submit arrow (circle with right-arrow) – likely accent colored or highlighted when active.
*   **Positioning:** Fixed to bottom of right panel with margin (~16px).

### 5. Color Scheme & Theme
*   **Mode:** **Dark Theme** (OLED-friendly blacks).
*   **Backgrounds:**
    *   Base/Absolute Black: `#000000` (Center stage)
    *   Surface Dark: `#121212` or `#1e1e1e` (Sidebars/Panel)
    *   Elevated/Surface Lighter: `#2d2d2d` or `#333333` (Cards, Input fields, Active nav)
    *   Header: `#1a1a1a` (subtle lift from sidebars)
*   **Text Colors:**
    *   Primary Text: `#e8eaed` (Off-white)
    *   Secondary Text: `#9aa0a6` (Medium gray)
    *   Tertiary/Disabled: `#5f6368` (Dark gray)
*   **Accents:** Minimal. The interface relies on depth (shades of gray) rather than color. Icons are primarily white or gray. The send button may use a subtle blue or remain monochrome until interacted with.

### 6. Typography & Distinctive UI Elements
*   **Font Family:** **Google Sans**, **Roboto**, or **Inter** (Clean, geometric sans-serif). 
    *   Headings: Medium weight (500).
    *   Body/UI: Regular (400).
*   **Icons:** 
    *   Style: **Material Symbols** (Rounded, filled or outlined depending on state).
    *   Size: 20px–24px in sidebar, 18px in header.
*   **Border Radius:** 
    *   Large/Soft: 12px–16px for cards and input containers.
    *   Full/Pill: 24px+ for the main input field.
    *   Small: 8px for buttons.
*   **Separators:** 1px solid lines in `#3c4043` used sparingly (only between nav sections in left sidebar).

### 7. Other Distinctive Details
*   **Global Header Elements:**
    *   **Left:** Home icon (house), Date/Time display ("Sep 12 - 05:30"), Kebab menu (three dots).
    *   **Center:** Search bar (rounded pill, dark gray, search icon inside), Filter/Funnel icon button.
    *   **Right:** Plus (+) icon, Help (?) icon, Settings (gear) icon, Kebab menu, User Avatar (circular, appears to be a photo or initial).
*   **Interaction Model:** The interface suggests a **"Studio" paradigm** rather than a traditional linear chat. The right panel is a modal-like session creator, while the center is the "stage" where results would appear.
*   **Pixel Art Element:** The central flower icon is distinctive—it suggests a generative/artistic focus, possibly rendered as a bitmap graphic rather than a vector icon.

**Implementation Tip for Developer:** Use CSS Grid for the three-column layout. Ensure the right panel has `overflow-y: auto` so the suggestion cards can scroll if the list grows, while keeping the input field pinned to the bottom (`position: sticky` or flexbox column with `margin-top: auto`).
